freckle.definition:
n. a small brownish spot (of the pigment melanin) on the skin
v. become freckled
v. mark with freckles
freckle.translation:
n. 雀斑, 斑点
[医] 非曝露部雀斑

freckled.definition: s. relating to or covered with or resembling freckles
freckled.translation: a. 雀斑, 斑点, 晒斑, (使)生雀斑, (使)生斑点

freckles.definition:
n a small brownish spot (of the pigment melanin) on the skin
v become freckled
v mark with freckles

freckling.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Freckle

n. 斑点
v. 雀斑, 斑点( freckle的现在分词 )

freckly.definition:
